article: Call the OpenAI Responses API from Windows Command Prompt with curl.exe
findings: Replaced the older /v1/chat/completions and gpt-3.5-turbo example with the currently recommended /v1/responses request shape and a model ID linked to the live catalog.
Removed the inline API-key placeholder and put the credential in a user environment variable; the request body is a separate UTF-8 JSON file and contains no secret.
Corrected Windows cmd.exe quoting/continuation and uses curl.exe, with HTTP headers/status visible and a note that PowerShell syntax differs.
Explained the Responses JSON output structure, model/project availability, separate ChatGPT/API billing, 401/429 troubleshooting, current pricing, and usage limits using official OpenAI references.
Removed the duplicate date while preserving the original 2025-02-01 publication date, added lastmod/localized metadata, and compared the full Japanese article with all twelve translations.
